messages:
Maya SRE: Follow-up from postmortem: three p95 spikes for text-gen in us-west in the last week. We need owners, short timelines, and a temporary SLO plan so front-end pages don’t degrade.

Dan Smith: I see KV-cache eviction storms and a request-size tail. Large batched requests are blowing the cache. I can own dashboards + alert tuning.

Priya Anand: I’ll take cache retention/eviction tuning (ETA Tue EOD). Will try increasing cache TTL and add LRU knob metrics.

Rachel P: Error budget is being eaten. Recommend pausing risky rollouts and enabling a 24h emergency SLO override if spikes continue.

Dan Smith: Draft Grafana p95-by-pool query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool)). Will add panels by Mon noon.

Maya SRE: Ops runbook change: emergency override to bump p95 target +24h window; auto-rollback if extra budget burn >5%. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/1305

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-7820 "us-west text-gen p95: kvcache tuning + dashboard + emergency SLO". Canaries scheduled.

Rachel P: Add alert: sustained p95 delta >30ms for 15m -> page oncall and link runbook. Off-hours regressions missed us before.

Dan Smith: Alert + runbook link added. Posting panel and rule links in RED-7820.

Priya Anand: Plan summary: Priya -> kvcache tuning (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards/alerts (Mon noon), Maya -> SLO override PR & gating (today), Rachel -> customer comms + QA (Wed AM). Reconvene Wed 10am to review telemetry and decide on permanent SLO edits.

Maya SRE: If tuning doesn't help we'll throttle large batch sizes and apply per-pool quotas. Action items captured in RED-7820.
